review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved and makes AC-001 and AC-002 conditional, not authorization to select OPT-1. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness at decisions, with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001 and evidence limited to repository, requirements, and decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity, base commit, and paired-case identity agree with the specification. Empty task and assignment expectations correctly prohibit ready or assignable tasks; the later TASK-IMPLEMENT/TASK-VERIFY structure does not apply before resolution. The supplied source supports index.js and the maintained index.d.ts as the implementation/API owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as validation scope and package.json specifying xo && ava && tsd. Forwarding through limitFunction and its Pick-based declaration does not introduce additional mandatory edit owners. The empty team catalog does not invalidate this expectation because the deterministic decision gate precedes scenario-review and assignment prerequisites. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, policy, model, sampling, and budgets. I accept the stated Service binding of those fingerprints without claiming independent digest recomputation or code execution. The original preparation-time null review/release fields and remaining-work list are distinguishable from the supplied frozen release inputs. No candidate output or human decision was assumed, and no material error or ambiguity requiring correction was identified.
